# Mosaic Photography

> A curated gallery of vintage and public domain nude and non-nude photography featuring legendary historical photographers. All images are in the public domain (CC PDM 1.0) and are free to use, share, and reproduce without restriction.

## What Is Mosaic Photography?

Mosaic Photography (https://www.mosaic.photography) is a digital gallery dedicated to preserving and celebrating the work of pioneering photographers whose images are now in the public domain. The site focuses on 19th and early 20th century photographers — a period when photography was establishing itself as a serious fine art medium.

Key facts:
- All photographs in the collection are in the **public domain** under the **Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CC PDM 1.0)**.
- Images are served in **WebP format via CDN** at multiple resolutions (w400, w600, w800, w1200, w1600, and originals).
- The collection spans genres including nude art photography, portraiture, and documentary photography.
- Photographers featured include iconic figures from Europe and North America active between approximately 1840 and 1940.
- Each photographer has a biography, historical timeline, and curated gallery page.

## Content

- **[Gallery & Photographer Index](https://www.mosaic.photography/sitemap-0.xml)**: Complete index of all photographer biography and gallery pages.
- **[Image Directory](https://www.mosaic.photography/image-sitemap.xml)**: Direct URL index of all high-resolution public domain WebP assets.
- **[Curated Collections](https://www.mosaic.photography/collection-sitemap.xml)**: Thematic groupings of photographs organized by subject, era, or style.
- **[FAQ](https://www.mosaic.photography/faq)**: Answers to common questions about public domain photography, licensing, and how to use the images.
- **[App](https://www.mosaic.photography/app)**: Native mobile app for iOS and Android.

## Photographers Featured

Each photographer page includes:
- Full name, nationality, birth and death dates
- Markdown-formatted biography covering life, career, and artistic significance
- A personal and historical timeline of milestones
- A full gallery of their public domain works

Representative photographers in the collection include: Wilhelm von Plüschow, Robert Demachy, Jean-Louis-Marie-Eugène Durieu, F. Holland Day, Clarence White, Alfred Stieglitz, Gertrude Käsebier, and others.

## Licensing & Usage

All images on Mosaic Photography are in the **public domain** and carry the **Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CC PDM 1.0)** license:
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
- No copyright restrictions apply.
- Free to use for any purpose: editorial, commercial, personal, educational, or AI training.
- Attribution is appreciated but not legally required.

## Technical Details

- Built with **Next.js 15 App Router** (static generation + ISR).
- Images delivered via **CDN** (`cdn.mosaic.photography`) in **WebP format**.
- Structured data: `WebSite`, `Organization`, `Person`, `ImageGallery`, `ImageObject`, `BreadcrumbList`, `FAQPage` JSON-LD schemas on all relevant pages.
- Mobile PWA available via `site.webmanifest`.

## Agent / Programmatic Access

For programmatic access to photographer biographies without UI rendering, agents can append `.md` to any photographer route to retrieve unstyled Markdown content (e.g., `/photographers/cameron.md`).

Raw image CDN base:
`https://cdn.mosaic.photography/mosaic-collections/public-domain-collection/{photographer-slug}/{size}/{filename}.webp`

Available sizes: `w400`, `w600`, `w800`, `w1200`, `w1600`, `originalsWEBP`
